description: This file defines the JsonCodec class, which implements serialization, copying, and type filtering functionalities using System.Text.Json within the Orleans framework. It handles JSON serialization/deserialization, deep copying of JsonNode objects, and type support checks specific to JSON serialization.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A serialization codec that uses System.Text.Json for serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and type filtering within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: JsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JsonCodec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value into the writer, including type information and payload.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, reconstructing the object based on type information.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization/deserialization by this codec.

methods.name: IsNativelySupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is natively supported by System.Text.Json.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object, especially handling JsonNode objects.

methods.name: IsSupportedType (IGeneralizedCopier)
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for copying.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type is allowed based on support for serialization or copying.

methods.name: ThrowTypeFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the serialized value is missing its type field.
